title: Home · Heat pump
description: The NIBE F750 exhaust-air heat pump through the myUplink API, polled once a minute. Read-only: the poller's token cannot change settings.

panels.title: Shower time left

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (SELECT 9.0 + 4.0 * cos(2 * pi() * (extract(month FROM now()) - 8.5) / 12) AS cold)
SELECT time, CASE WHEN value <= 40.0 THEN 0 ELSE
       180 * 0.86 * (value - cold) / (40.0 - cold) / 4.8 END AS "Our estimate"
FROM nibe, c
WHERE id = '40013' AND time > now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Showers left

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (SELECT 9.0 + 4.0 * cos(2 * pi() * (extract(month FROM now()) - 8.5) / 12) AS cold)
SELECT time, CASE WHEN value <= 40.0 THEN 0 ELSE
       180 * 0.86 * (value - cold) / (40.0 - cold) / 65.0 END AS "Showers"
FROM nibe, c
WHERE id = '40013' AND time > now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Water use

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('10 minutes', time) AS time, sum(rate) AS "Value"
FROM mqtt_consumer
WHERE integration_id IS NULL AND device_id IS NULL AND name = 'watermeter' AND $__timeFilter(time)
  AND rate > -20 AND rate < 20
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heat produced per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, point, max(value) - min(value) AS "Value"
FROM nibe JOIN (VALUES ('44308', 'Heating, compressor'), ('44306', 'Hot water, compressor')) AS n (id, point) USING (id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND id IN ('44308', '44306')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH total AS (
SELECT time, sum(s) AS v FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, id, max(value) - min(value) AS s
  FROM nibe WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND id IN ('44300', '44298') GROUP BY 1, 2) d
GROUP BY 1), comp AS (
SELECT time, sum(s) AS v FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, id, max(value) - min(value) AS s
  FROM nibe WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND id IN ('44308', '44306') GROUP BY 1, 2) d
GROUP BY 1)
SELECT time, 'Electric heater' AS point, total.v - comp.v AS "Value"
FROM total JOIN comp USING (time) ORDER BY 1

FROM nibe JOIN (VALUES ('43144', 'Compressor')) AS n (id, point) USING (id)

panels.description: The pump's own compressor energy counter (myUplink calls it "time factor").

panels.title: Heat per compressor kWh

targets.rawSql:
WITH heat AS (
SELECT time, sum(s) AS v FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, id, max(value) - min(value) AS s
  FROM nibe WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND id IN ('44308', '44306') GROUP BY 1, 2) d
GROUP BY 1), elec AS (
SELECT time, sum(s) AS v FROM (
  SELECT time_bucket('1 day', time, 'Europe/Helsinki') AS time, id, max(value) - min(value) AS s
  FROM nibe WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND id IN ('43144') GROUP BY 1, 2) d
GROUP BY 1)
SELECT time, heat.v / elec.v AS "Value"
FROM heat JOIN elec USING (time) WHERE elec.v > 0.5 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Compressor heat divided by the compressor energy counter: an efficiency estimate from the pump's own counters, not a measured COP (fans and pumps are not included).

panels.title: Settings

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) setting AS "Setting", value AS "Value"
FROM nibe JOIN (VALUES ('47007', 'Heating curve'), ('47011', 'Curve offset'), ('47041', 'Hot water demand (0 eco, 1 normal, 2 lux)'), ('47137', 'Operating mode (0 auto)'), ('47212', 'Max electric heater (×10 W)'), ('47206', 'Compressor starts at (DM)'), ('48072', 'Heater allowed from (DM below start)'), ('47375', 'Stop heating above (°C)'), ('47376', 'Stop electric heater above (°C)'), ('48442', 'Smart Price Adaption on'), ('48444', 'Price effect on room temperature'), ('48566', 'Price effect on hot water'), ('47050', 'Periodic hot-water boost on'), ('47051', 'Boost every (days)')) AS n (id, setting) USING (id)
WHERE time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND id IN ('47007', '47011', '47041', '47137', '47212', '47206', '48072', '47375', '47376', '48442', '48444', '48566', '47050', '47051')
ORDER BY id, time DESC

panels.description: Current values of settings that matter for comfort and cost. Change them on the pump or in myUplink.

panels.title: Setting changes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), point, last(value, time) AS "Value"
FROM nibe JOIN (VALUES ('47007', 'Heating curve'), ('47011', 'Curve offset'), ('47041', 'Hot water demand')) AS n (id, point) USING (id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND id IN ('47007', '47011', '47041')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
